name: Pressurizer Relief Valve Stuck Partially Open
description: A pressurizer power-operated relief valve sticks ~35% open. Primary pressure and pressurizer level fall as inventory is lost through the valve; if uncorrected the low-pressure and low-level reactor trips actuate.
briefing: A relief valve fails partly open at t+25 s. Diagnose the slow depressurisation (valve position vs. heater demand vs. real leak) and act before protection setpoints are reached.
learning_objectives: Primary inventory and pressure control via the pressurizer
A small break / stuck-open valve as a loss-of-inventory event
Reading heater demand and valve position to localise the fault
